subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) KMH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67f518144511dd6e12871966e03ea105e7871fd39c08d13bcf15cb4c5cb61750.png] 

Option 2) QSN

Option 3) GDH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f02a313374711d7e06010869f00f7909983c9cd211341c8dcb81d8e7e53218a.png] 

​Option 4) HJE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c724b81a196dba9c2642ae999d12fe0fd7d0e4cf8c6a8ebb344609934f41e19.png]
